title: Update and immutable lock mapping
summary: M5 implementation map of ownership-aware portable init/update behavior, immutable package and Framework state, deterministic apply and verified rollback.
current_behavior: Framework runtime, manifests and asset projection are pinned to commit hashes and validated fail closed; the current exact distribution includes the Framework-owned shared UI-radius contract.
init creates project-owned JSON/Markdown plus a versioned package-owned engine state only in an empty target.
update verifies ownership, writes a hash-bound dry-run plan, applies by atomic engine-directory swap and preserves a validated rollback package.
project-owned files are never update targets; dirty, unknown, symlinked, stale or corrupt state fails closed.
Composer archive and git export exclude local/development surfaces; a fresh dist consumer lock resolves the exact package revision and immutable direct dependency tuple.
README, CLI help and public docs expose the same explicit init/update/build/verify/serve contract and the tested add/rename/delete full-build boundary.
deletion_gates: Independent acceptance must reproduce the exported archive and fresh consumer lock matrix without mutating the candidate.
Do not change Framework locks without exact tuple compatibility and asset projection evidence.
Prove the documented consumer-owned dependency lock against the exported archive before claiming reproducible clean installation.
